params.body:
## Why

Two things on Beheer > Portalen after #1016:

- A Hexon portal added and then switched off ("Aangeboden" off) vanished from Hexon's list on the same screen. It was not lost: it sat folded under "1 portaal uit het aanbod tonen". But the place it was picked from is where an administrator looks for it again (Alfa Romeo België, 15 October 2026).
- The lead under the page head touched the card below it, on Beheer > Portalen and on Beheer > Functies alike: `.ui-page-lead` has only a top margin.

## What

- Hexon's list now also shows the links whose portal is out of the offer, with "Weer aanbieden" instead of "Toevoegen". The button puts the same row back in the offer (`offered = 1`); it never creates a second row, so the garages and vehicles on it stay with it. Only offered portals are left out of the list. The code-fix picker still leaves out every code in use.
- The two lead paragraphs get `margin-bottom: var(--ui-s-4)` on the element. Not in `refresh.css`: that file is on the quality ratchet and may only shrink.
- Texts in nl, fr, en, de (`portals.offer_again`); rule R S2-4.10 extended.

## Checks

- New test: add a Hexon portal, switch it off, find it in Hexon's list with "Weer aanbieden", offer it again: one row, offered.
- Full suite: 3107 tests OK (2 skipped, 1 incomplete, as on main), including `QualityRatchetTest`. PHPStan: no errors. Pint on the touched PHP.
